008package paint.viewer.io;
009
010import javax.swing.*;
011import java.awt.*;
012import java.awt.image.BufferedImage;
013import java.nio.file.Files;
014import java.nio.file.Path;
015
016/**
017 * Static utility for exporting Swing panels as high-resolution PNG images. This class cannot
018 * be instantiated.
019 * <p>
020 * Provides a high-resolution PNG export for Swing panels used in the PAINT Viewer (e.g., the
021 * left square grid panel).
022 * </p>
023 * <p>
024 * This utility class renders any Swing {@link JPanel} to an off-screen {@link BufferedImage}
025 * at an arbitrary scaling factor. High-quality rendering hints are applied to ensure smooth
026 * edges, sharp text, and correct scaling of overlays such as square outlines or shading
027 * layers. The exported image is written as a PNG to the specified file path. Directories are
028 * created automatically if necessary.
029 * </p>
030 * <ul>
031 *   <li>High-resolution PNG exports using scalable rendering.</li>
032 *   <li>High-quality antialiasing, interpolation, and rendering hints.</li>
033 *   <li>Simple one-method API: {@code export(panel, output, scale)}.</li>
034 *   <li>Pure utility class — cannot be instantiated.</li>
035 * </ul>
036 */
037public final class PanelExporter {
038
039    /** Prevent instantiation. */
040    private PanelExporter() { }
041
042    /**
043     * Exports the given {@link JPanel} to a PNG image at a specified scaling factor.
044     * All visual overlays painted on the panel are included.
045     *
046     * <p><strong>Example:</strong><br>
047     * {@code export(leftGridPanel, Path.of("output.png"), 2.0);} produces a
048     * double-resolution export suitable for publication-quality figures.</p>
049     *
050     * @param panel  the panel to render
051     * @param output the destination PNG file
052     * @param scale  scale factor (1.0 = current on-screen size)
053     *
054     * @throws Exception if rendering or writing fails
055     */
056    public static void export(JPanel panel, Path output, double scale) throws Exception {
057
058        // Compute scaled output dimensions
059        int width  = (int) (panel.getWidth()  * scale);
060        int height = (int) (panel.getHeight() * scale);
061
062        // Create image buffer
063        BufferedImage img = new BufferedImage(width, height, BufferedImage.TYPE_INT_RGB);
064
065        Graphics2D g2 = img.createGraphics();
066
067        // High-quality rendering hints
068        g2.setRenderingHint(RenderingHints.KEY_ANTIALIASING,
069                            RenderingHints.VALUE_ANTIALIAS_ON);
070        g2.setRenderingHint(RenderingHints.KEY_RENDERING,
071                            RenderingHints.VALUE_RENDER_QUALITY);
072        g2.setRenderingHint(RenderingHints.KEY_INTERPOLATION,
073                            RenderingHints.VALUE_INTERPOLATION_BICUBIC);
074
075        // Apply scaling and render the panel
076        g2.scale(scale, scale);
077        panel.paintAll(g2);
078        g2.dispose();
079
080        // Ensure directory exists
081        if (output.getParent() != null) {
082            Files.createDirectories(output.getParent());
083        }
084
085        // Write PNG
086        javax.imageio.ImageIO.write(img, "png", output.toFile());
087    }
088}
